Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain blocked/P3/user-deferred; this is an unstarted authority migration, not a completed extraction or current implementation task. build.sbt still publishes scalafim-fmri-motion on JVM/JS, depends on image/image4s geometry and adds bids4s on JVM. It references reframe4s lie/field/resample, but has no reframe4s-motion ProjectRef; the existing reframe4s integration therefore does not prove motion replacement. Current motion sources still include RigidPose, MotionTrace, MotionEstimator/application, MotionQc and JVM MotionBids/MotionNifti/MotionReportWriter/MotionCli. No Scala references to scalafim.fmri.motion were found outside the module in the module/example scan; this does not establish absence of external users or authorize deleting a published surface.

Retain the explicit original user activation condition. Current core-stabilization work may repair existing motion numerics without resuming wholesale provider migration; the remaining solve6 ownership review is tracked by bd-01KXYJPWYV08VFWRMCYYDPZCAV. At any future activation, refresh the exact provider revision/capabilities and consumer inventory, consciously preserve or retire the actual JVM IO/QC surface, and reconcile module-relations claims with the actual retained artifact. No new dependencies, code changes, tests, provider capability qualification or permission to resume the migration is implied by this assessment.
